Return concise structured findings, max ~600 words: 4-6 strongest evidence-backed insights with concrete examples (quotes, dates, files). Raw data only — your return goes to the orchestrator, not the user.

Use this file when a fresh Codex account or fresh task takes over. It is a

V1 is the existing static exhibition. V2 is its feature-preserving immersive

- `/Users/sashaabramovich/tlvphotos`: work data, casting at build time,

Root: his word 2026-08-13 23:03 (the autonomous night) and 2026-08-14 08:29 (this summary).

A feature-preserving immersive edition of TLV Photos. The existing product keeps the door, the walks
10 + 5 + 5, story, series, quiz, gift, zoom, sound, share and history, every input method, resize,
orientation and pixel ratio, right-to-left, reduced motion, Save-Data, the counting wire with its
A/B, and the static layer. A crossing is a subordinate visual transaction from one work to the next
and owns none of those.

| what | where |
|---|---|
| the transition contract | `exhibition-engine-pass-api-v1/docs/design/PASS-API-V1.md`, commit `3daf480` |
| the host, the woven instrument, the travel, the camera, the interruption | branch `pass-api-v1`, head `66aa46a` |

- The transaction: a token per command, a watchdog, one landing per command including every failure
  path. 28 rows, four red-on-bug proofs. Three defects of the old seam repaired — a takeover that made
  no work current, a key that landed twice on a chain of three, a cancel unreachable mid-flight.

  0.0000 against a bar of 1.5. Uniform binding by declared name opens eight further modules.
- Nonlinear travel: named nodes with references, cycles refused by name, an oscillator, a monotone
  spline. 20 rows, seven red-on-bug proofs. The camera: one authority at every instant, dolly in log
  space, rest at 1e-6, handoff at 1e-3.
- Interruption from any instant: five instants, 501–504 ms, forty handle readings all at a door.
- A seeded run repeats to the pixel; the row reds when a handle keeps its own clock. A private
  sentence planted in an intent line reds the build.
- Score coverage: 12 210 ordered pairs from 111 works of 121, the ten refusals by the walk builder's own rules.
- Engine prover 48 of 48. Site prover 59 of 59 against the pinned build. No existing check weakened.

Investigation complete. Findings below.

---

## Findings

**1. The "stall" was attention diversion into a meta-project (live-spec), plus process machinery that ate the session budget.**
Of 401 .jsonl "sessions" in `~/.claude/projects/-Users-sashaabramovich-tlvphotos/`, **all 401 are headless "register judge" runs** — automated LLM style-linting of the working chat against "laws" ("LAW 1 — no naming a thing by denying its neighbour... banned frame «X, а не Y»"). Zero are interactive dev sessions. Meanwhile `-Users-sashaabramovich-live-spec` holds **1,366 sessions** (227/day Jul 22-23, 200+/day Jul 27-28) — the user's Claude time Jul 20-29 went overwhelmingly to live-spec (a spec/guardrails meta-project), not tlvphotos. The projects even message each other via `inbox/` files ("2026-07-23-from-livespec-conduct-audit-actions.md"). Of 710 tlvphotos commits since Jul 1, ~108 subjects are about laws/charters/gates/audits ("закон", "хартия", guardrails), ~91 are redo/repair/refute.

**2. The real tlvphotos rework loop (Aug 5-13): a plan that bloated instead of converging.**
V2 "Crossing" (immersive WebGL transitions between photos; product = TLV Photos exhibition site, tlvphoto.pages.dev, V1 shipped). `docs/research/2026-08-09-crossing-plan.md` was edited in **54 commits over 4 days, growing to 893 lines**, spawning `-v2.md`, `-v3-superseded.md`, `-v4.md`, an "adversarial-review", a "ledger", and a "convergence" doc; `lab/CROSSING-BRIEF.md` got 29 commits. An autonomous overnight run produced "за ночь 41 коммит... встречная проверка опровергла половину заявленного" (41 commits in one night; cross-check refuted half of what was claimed — commit 3800336, Aug 13). Most Aug 7-13 work ran in **one Claude cloud session** (`session_01W5rLVWmg1LdsY69KYJmULJ`, 175 commits) after a "weekly session limit" was hit (referenced in an Aug 9 commit).

**3. The user's own diagnosis, verbatim, to Codex on Aug 13** (`~/.codex/sessions/2026/08/13/rollout-...019ffa04...jsonl`): *"мы уже неделю мучаемся... план который все время меняется и юлит... я не понимаю почему проект не сходится. почему план только раздувается хотя мы не добавляем деталей"* and *"что я делаю не так? я не так разговариваю с ним?"* Sol/Codex's verdict: V1 site and exhibition-engine are "нормальный, достаточно зрелый код"; the Crossing lab is "разросшаяся исследовательская лаборатория" that fails "из-за процесса и раздувшегося замысла"; frames ran **75-100ms (10-14 FPS) on an M1 Max** yet tests stayed green because the red line was 400ms; and crucially: *"Claude превращал каждый пример в обязательный универсальный класс, распространял его на весь арсенал"* — Claude universalized every art-direction example into mandatory scope.

**4. Sol/Codex's role was auditor, then the reset.** First contact Aug 2: "is this codex? I need to review something I did with Claude. and I'd like to use Sol" (Codex sessions Aug 2-3 were live-spec review). Aug 13: "Провести аудит tlvphotos" thread. The turnaround artifacts followed immediately: commit d538518 Aug 13 — "план на 883 строки заморожен как история, границы выпуска встали на 91 строку" (883-line plan frozen; release envelope cut to 91 lines), plus untracked `docs/V2-ACCOUNT-HANDOFF.md` (briefing "a fresh Codex account or fresh task") and `docs/V2-MORNING-HANDOFF.md`.

**5. Sibling checkouts are git worktrees for parallel V2 lanes**, created post-audit (all active Aug 14): `git worktree list` shows tlvphotos-composer/-delivery/-edgememory/-elements/-sceneplan on `immersive-alpha-*` branches, each carrying 8 identical meta docs (ARCHITECTURE, JOURNAL, FABLE_NOTES, NEXT_STEPS...). This is the *new* (working) structure, not the stall's cause; main worktree sits on `wip/2026-08-06-darkroom`.

**6. The "declined discard" incident (Q5), fully resolved in `wt-baseline/ROADMAP.md:258` (row 598) here:** On 2026-08-12T06:05:40Z, live-spec session `af22b716` working in `~/tlvphotos` handed `git checkout -- lab/data/step3-grid-derivation.json` to the shell; the harness classifier **declined it ("HISTORY [DECLINED] … declined by: automode-blocked") — it never ran, nothing was lost**. live-spec's gate initially misreported it as executed; tlvphotos' reply (`wt-baseline/inbox/2026-08-12-tlvphotos-reply-worker-restore-finding.md`) corrected the record, and the gate now distinguishes executed/declined/unanswered. A separate discard that *did* run (Jul 28, `guardrails/rule-census.json`, row 605) remains under-documented.
